featured_reviews.review_text: I’ve had a very bad experience. First I book an appointment with Practo. Practo confirms it. I arrive 30 minutes late. My bad. But then I was told the Doctor I booked with isn’t with them anymore, then I was like ok is there another Prosthodontics? they say yes. I wait. Then they tell me Doctor has other appointments then I loose it a bit like why would you confirm my appointment with the doctor I wanted to consult with and then you wanted me to wait only to tell me Doc has other appointments. By now the receptionist understood that this can escalate. They give me a slot. I wait for another 30. I meet the doc and say my bite isn’t correct, Ihave lost a few molars and I want a rehabilitation. I want to correct my bite and symmetry both. The doc examined me and says we should do it in two phases. Put implants and put veneers on all my teeth. My concern with bite correction was totally ignored for the money implants can get them. I immediately left. Wrong practice. Please visit a traditional dentist. These guys are there only to make money and not fix your teeth related concerns. Be careful there are many out there.

The consultation you had was an initial assessment, where the doctor evaluates the condition and discusses possible treatment directions. 
For more complex situations involving missing teeth, bite imbalance, and rehabilitation, the first consultation is only meant to understand the problem and outline possible approaches.

Detailed treatment planning is usually done in subsequent discussions, where we carefully consider the patient’s goals, expectations, and preferences before any treatment begins.

We regret if this process was not communicated clearly during your visit. Our intention is always to provide ethical, long-term solutions tailored to each patient’s needs, and never to recommend treatment without proper discussion and understanding.

If you would be open to it, we would be happy to review your concerns again and explain all available options in detail.

Thank you.

American Dental Practices.

Dr Rohit is very soft-spoken, patient and a  highly knowledgeable Dentist. Just a quick backstory, I had a minor tooth ache a few days back and had previously gone to a different dentist who recommended 10 different things which freaked me out.

Later on after close examination I was recommended a root canal. As a person I'm very scared of needles and injections. Dr. Rohit made sure that my root canal was painless and did the procedure with a hell lot of patience and in one sitting. I have seen him treat patients who come from very low caste families and he treats them and gives everyone the same amount of time. His charges are also quite reasonable and mind you it isn't the same for everyone which just makes it so much easier for people who can't afford paying for root canals and other expensive treatments.

All in all, hands down the best Dentist and I would highly recommend him to everyone.
